text:
Avery: Ok team — we need a tight benchmark narrative for launch week. Focus: latency v cost tradeoff that speaks to platform buyers and engineers. Two asks: 1) one clear hero chart for the blog/post, 2) 2 supporting visuals for slides/webinar. Quick takes?

Ravi: For hero chart I still lean on a scatter: latency (p50) on x, normalized cost per 1k tokens on y, color by model tier. It shows clear frontier and makes routing decisions tangible.

Sofia: +1 on scatter but can we include shading for SLO bands (e.g., <200ms, 200–500ms) so product teams see where their app fits?

Liam: Love the SLO shading. Also recommend a small inset that shows batching impact (same model, latency vs cost with/without batching). Engineers will appreciate that nuance.

Maya: For messaging: headline option A: "Pick performance, not compromise" — calls out latency/cost directly. Option B: "Pay less for predictable latency" — more enterprise-friendly. Thoughts?

Avery: I like A for PLG landing, B for enterprise/email nurture. We'll split CTAs based on routing (self-serve vs sales).

Ravi: Ran a fresh set of microbenchmarks this morning. Raw numbers (summary):
```
model_a: p50 120ms, cost_norm 1.0
model_b-quant: p50 210ms, cost_norm 0.45
model_c-8bit: p50 340ms, cost_norm 0.25
```
I'll push complete CSV to the shared drive.

bench-bot: Benchmark run complete: run_id=2026-11-14_03, artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/2026-11-14_03/report.html, sample_prompts.csv.

Jordan: Can we make one slide that tells the routing story? e.g., if latency <250ms route to model A, else route to cost-optimized variant. Show fallback arrows and expected cost delta.

Sofia: Also add a small customer-case micro-slice: "chat widget on e-commerce site" — shows they saved 40% token cost by routing while keeping p95 fallbacks. Makes it concrete.

Liam: For visuals: 1) hero scatter with SLO bands, 2) mini flow diagram for routing + delta table, 3) small before/after batching inset. Provide color palette and annotations.

Maya: Webinar asks: 15–20 min walkthrough of charts + 10 min Q&A. Landing form should have a checkbox for "I want dedicated capacity pricing" to route to sales.

Avery: Action items: Ravi upload CSV + figure export by EOD, Sofia draft copy for PLG + enterprise headlines, Liam build slide mockups, Maya wire landing form and webinar registration flow, Jordan draft routing diagram. Sync 10:30am tomorrow for review.

Ravi: Uploaded artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/bench/2026-11-14_03/report.html and CSV. I'll also export hero fig in SVG.

Sofia: Draft copy in Figma page "bench-narrative-copy" — added both headlines and micro-slice bullets.

Liam: Slide mocks pushed to the shared deck — filename: bench-launch-v1.pptx. Comments welcome.

Maya: Landing form draft posted in Notion with routing rules for leads. Will add webinar copy after review.

Avery: Great. If we can lock hero chart + headline by noon tomorrow we can get design time for final art. :thumbsup:

Jordan: I'm good for 10:30 sync. Will bring a simple sequence diagram for routing fallback.

bench-bot: Reminder: next benchmark scheduled 2026-11-21_03 — run window reserved.

Avery: Thanks everyone — small, focused doc after sync and we'll pick the one hero and two supporting charts for launch assets.

Liam: tiny nit — can we make the hero render at 1200x600 so it fits blog header?

Ravi: noted, exporting at 1200x600 svg/png.

Sofia: tagging @design for annotations.

Maya: I'll add the checkbox routing to the form and wire it to inbound lead playbook.

Avery: Perfect. See you all tomorrow. :rocket:
